zh.title: 波音任命高爾航空前執行長費雷爾為拉丁美洲總裁
zh.summary: 波音任命高爾航空前執行長費雷爾出任拉丁美洲總裁；9月4日生效
body: 波音公司宣布任命塞爾索·費雷爾（Celso Ferrer）出任波音拉丁美洲與加勒比海地區總裁，該項人事任命將於2026年9月4日正式生效。費雷爾履新後，將負責強化波音在該區域的營運、策略與業務據點，並支持拉丁美洲及加勒比海地區的成長機會。
在加入波音之前，費雷爾曾擔任高爾航空（GOL Linhas Aéreas）執行長達四年時間。他過去亦曾在高爾航空擔任營運長及規劃副總裁等高階管理職務。此外，費雷爾是一名現役合格的民航飛行員，曾為高爾航空的波音737機隊執行飛行任務。
學歷方面，費雷爾擁有聖保羅大學（USP）經濟學學位、聖保羅天主教大學（PUC-SP）國際關係學位，以及位於法國的歐洲工商管理學院（INSEAD）高階管理碩士學位。

en.title: Boeing Names Former GOL Chief Celso Ferrer President for Latin America
en.summary: Boeing appoints former GOL chief Celso Ferrer as Latin America president, effective September 4.
body: Boeing has appointed Celso Ferrer as president of Boeing Latin America and the Caribbean, effective September 4, 2026. In this role, he will be responsible for strengthening the company's operations, strategy, and regional presence, as well as supporting growth opportunities throughout Latin America and the Caribbean.

Prior to joining Boeing, Ferrer served for four years as Chief Executive Officer of GOL Linhas Aéreas. He previously held leadership roles at the airline as Chief Operating Officer and Vice President of Planning. Ferrer is also an experienced, currently certified airline pilot who flew as part of GOL's flight crew on the Boeing 737 fleet.
Ferrer holds a degree in Economics from the University of São Paulo (USP), a degree in International Relations from PUC-SP, and an Executive MBA from INSEAD in France.
